devices.forget_cooldown: Just flashed and restarting: it can be forgotten once its cooldown is over.

settings.title: Settings

code.dialog_failed: The file dialog could not be opened.
code.log_io: Could not write the log file.
code.no_home: Your home folder could not be found.
code.packages_unavailable: The package list is not available: {cause}.
code.settings_newer: The settings were written by a newer version of Mac Netinstall (settings version {version}; this app knows {supported}). They are used, but not changed, so the newer app's file stays intact.
hint.no_ipv4: Give it a fixed address: System Settings → Network → the adapter → Details → TCP/IP → Configure IPv4: Manually (IP address 192.168.88.1, subnet mask 255.255.255.0).
hint.no_manual_ipv4: Open System Settings → Network → {service} → Details → TCP/IP, set Configure IPv4 to Manually, IP address 192.168.88.1, subnet mask 255.255.255.0, then click OK.
hint.settings_newer: Update Mac Netinstall to change the settings.
hint.ipv4_dhcp: Switch it to a fixed address: System Settings → Network → {service} → Details → TCP/IP, set Configure IPv4 to Manually, IP address 192.168.88.1, subnet mask 255.255.255.0.
hint.port_in_use: Another DHCP or TFTP server is running, most likely Internet Sharing (System Settings → General → Sharing). Turn it off and try again.
hint.link_down: Plug in the cable and power on the router. macOS hides a fixed address while there is no cable; you can start anyway.
hint.unsuitable_interface: Choose a wired Ethernet adapter (built-in, USB, Thunderbolt or a dock).
hint.interface_not_ethernet: Choose a wired Ethernet adapter (built-in, USB, Thunderbolt or a dock). Wi-Fi, Thunderbolt ports (IP over Thunderbolt), bridges and virtual interfaces cannot netinstall a RouterBOARD.
hint.no_mac: macOS hides this interface's hardware address. Use a wired Ethernet adapter.
hint.default_route: Devices on that network could get addresses from this app. Use a separate adapter connected only to the router.
hint.server_ip_not_on_interface: Set this address on the interface in System Settings → Network, or change the server IP in Settings.
hint.kernels_unavailable: Connect to the internet once so the boot kernels can be downloaded; they are kept in the cache afterwards.
hint.version_unavailable: Check the internet connection, or the version in the profile.
hint.send_failed: If this keeps happening, allow Mac Netinstall under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network.
hint.script_missing: Open the profile and choose the script again.
